name: colgrep-agent-2B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: GQA, 16 query heads and 2 kv heads
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A rl of openbmb/MiniCPM5-2B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 2.517 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-10-03. CAVEATS: the benchmark is code-localization, not issue resolution - SWE-bench Lite was re-cut into file/line F1 by the authors' own methodology, so these are not SWE-bench resolve rates and must not be compared to them. Grandmaster caveat: 2B model trained with Qwen3.5-27B as the SFT teacher; it still trails gemma-4-31B-it on File F1 (79.93 vs 76.18) in the same table.
